# Air-broadening of CO2 lines in the 30013←00001 band (synthetic test document)

## Abstract

This is a synthetic document used only for automated tests. Its numbers are made up.

## 1. Introduction

Accurate pressure broadening parameters are needed for remote sensing of carbon dioxide.

## 2. Experimental setup

Spectra were recorded with a Fourier transform spectrometer at 296 K and total pressures between 20 and 200 Torr.

## 3. Results

The air-broadened half-width of the R(10) line of 12C16O2 was found to be 0.0712(3) cm−1 atm−1 at 296 K.

| Line | γ_air (cm−1 atm−1) | n_air |
|------|--------------------|-------|
| R(10) | 0.0712 | 0.74 |
| R(12) | 0.0698 | 0.73 |

## 4. Conclusion

The results agree with previous measurements within 1%.
